name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Between Fork and Skewer, one goes with Caro-Kann and the other with French.
If Vera goes with Pirc, then Fork goes with French.
Exactly two of these are true: Magnus goes with London; Magnus goes with Gambit; French goes with Gambit.
Either Nadia goes with Fork or someone in the Evening Study Group goes with Judit.
If Sacrifice does not go with French, then Skewer goes with Judit.

hints.text: Suppose Judit went with Fork — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Judit goes with Fork.
Fork goes with Judit, so Nadia can't go with Fork.
…but now the clue “Either Nadia goes with Fork or someone in the Evening Study Group goes with Judit” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Judit does not go with Fork.
